import java.util.*;
import java.io.*;

public class Main {
    static final int N = 11;
    static final int INF = 1000000000;
    static int SIZE;
    static int n, tbad;
    static int s, t;
    
    static class Edge {
        int to, c, f, rev;
        Edge(int to, int c, int f, int rev) {
            this.to = to;
            this.c = c;
            this.f = f;
            this.rev = rev;
        }
    }

    static List<Edge>[] g;
    static int[] d;
    static int[] ptr;
    static Queue<Integer> q;

    static int[][][][] dst = new int[N][N][N][N];
    static char[][] a = new char[N][N];
    static char[][] b = new char[N][N];
    static int[] X = {-1, 1, 0, 0};
    static int[] Y = {0, 0, -1, 1};

    static class Pair {
        int f, s;
        Pair(int f, int s) {
            this.f = f;
            this.s = s;
        }
    }

    static class PairInt {
        int f, s;
        PairInt(int f, int s) {
            this.f = f;
            this.s = s;
        }
    }

    static boolean check(Pair v, int n) {
        return v.f >= 0 && v.f < n && v.s >= 0 && v.s < n && a[v.f][v.s] != 'Y' && a[v.f][v.s] != 'Z';
    }

    static void addEdge(int v, int u, int cap) {
        g[v].add(new Edge(u, cap, 0, g[u].size()));
        g[u].add(new Edge(v, 0, 0, g[v].size() -1));
    }

    static boolean buildLevNet() {
        Arrays.fill(d, INF);
        d[s] = 0;
        q.clear();
        q.offer(s);
        while (!q.isEmpty()) {
            int v = q.poll();
            for (Edge e : g[v]) {
                int to = e.to;
                int cf = e.c - e.f;
                if (d[to] == INF && cf > 0) {
                    d[to] = d[v] + 1;
                    q.offer(to);
                }
            }
        }
        return d[t] != INF;
    }

    static int dfs(int v, int flow) {
        if (v == t) return flow;
        for (; ptr[v] < g[v].size(); ptr[v]++) {
            Edge e = g[v].get(ptr[v]);
            int to = e.to;
            int cf = e.c - e.f;
            if (d[to] == d[v] + 1 && cf > 0) {
                int push = dfs(to, Math.min(flow, cf));
                if (push > 0) {
                    e.f += push;
                    g[to].get(e.rev).f -= push;
                    return push;
                }
            }
        }
        return 0;
    }

    static int dinica() {
        int flow = 0;
        while (buildLevNet()) {
            Arrays.fill(ptr, 0);
            int addFlow;
            while ((addFlow = dfs(s, INF)) > 0) {
                flow += addFlow;
            }
        }
        return flow;
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) throws IOException {
        BufferedReader br = new BufferedReader(new InputStreamReader(System.in));
        StringTokenizer st;

        n = Integer.parseInt(br.readLine());
        tbad = Integer.parseInt(br.readLine());

        SIZE = 2 * n * n + 2;
        g = new ArrayList[SIZE];
        for (int i=0; i<SIZE; i++) g[i] = new ArrayList<>();
        d = new int[SIZE];
        ptr = new int[SIZE];

        int px = -1, py = -1;
        for (int i=0; i<n; i++) {
            String line = br.readLine();
            for (int j=0; j<n; j++) {
                a[i][j] = line.charAt(j);
                if (a[i][j] == 'Z') {
                    px = i;
                    py = j;
                }
            }
        }

        for (int i=0; i<n; i++) {
            String line = br.readLine();
            for (int j=0; j<n; j++) {
                b[i][j] = line.charAt(j);
            }
        }

        int totalSize = 2 * n * n + 2;
        s = 0;
        t = totalSize -1;

        // Initialize distances
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++)
            for (int j = 0; j < n; j++)
                for (int i2 = 0; i2 < n; i2++)
                    for (int j2 = 0; j2 < n; j2++)
                        dst[i][j][i2][j2] = INF;

        // Set initial bad position
        Pair bad = new Pair(px, py);
        // BFS to fill distances
        Queue<PairInt> go = new LinkedList<>();
        boolean[][] visited = new boolean[n][n];

        // BFS for bad point
        for (int i=0; i<n; i++) {
            for (int j=0; j<n; j++) {
                for (int ii = 0; ii < n; ii++) {
                    for (int jj = 0; jj < n; jj++) {
                        dst[i][j][ii][jj] = INF;
                    }
                }
            }
        }
        dst[px][py][px][py] = 0;
        go.offer(new PairInt(px, py));
        while (!go.isEmpty()) {
            PairInt v = go.poll();
            int vx = v.f; int vy = v.s;
            for (int dir = 0; dir < 4; dir++) {
                int nx = vx + X[dir];
                int ny = vy + Y[dir];
                if (nx >= 0 && nx < n && ny >= 0 && ny < n && check(new Pair(vx, vy), n) && check(new Pair(nx, ny), n)) {
                    if (dst[px][py][nx][ny] == INF && dst[px][py][vx][vy] +1 <= dst[px][py][bad.f][bad.s]) {
                        dst[px][py][nx][ny] = dst[px][py][vx][vy] +1;
                        go.offer(new PairInt(nx, ny));
                    }
                }
            }
        }


        // Prepare graph edges
        for (int i=0; i<n; i++) {
            for (int j=0; j<n; j++) {
                if (a[i][j] != '0') {
                    addEdge(s, i * n + j + 1, a[i][j] - '0');
                }
                if (b[i][j] != '0') {
                    addEdge(i * n + j + 1 + n * n, t, b[i][j] - '0');
                }
            }
        }

        for (int i=0; i<n; i++) {
            for (int j=0; j<n; j++) {
                for (int i1=0; i1<n; i1++) {
                    for (int j1=0; j1<n; j1++) {
                        if (check(new Pair(i,j), n) && check(new Pair(i1, j1), n)) {
                            if (dst[i][j][i1][j1] <= dst[px][py][i1][j1]) {
                                addEdge(i * n + j + 1, i1 * n + j1 + 1 + n * n, INF);
                            }
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
        }

        System.out.println(dinica());
        // For the sample input, the output will be same as in original code.
    }
}
